classification-desc: I unibetsidåt ma-ranka gi mina'siette gi halom i unibetsidåt siha gi Ehipto yan gi mina'bente unu gi halom i unibetsidåt siha gi Arab gi klasifikasion internasionåt nu i unibetsidåt Arab, ni ha na'i mås måtto i finatinas akademiku yan inestudion research segun på'go na kriterio.
college-number: Bente tres kolehio yan institutu siha
college-number-desc: I unibetsidåt ma-ranka 183 gi tano' entero gi Green Metric ranking, ni ha estapblesi kriterio para i berde na infrastruktura, areklamento i hanom yan energiha, tinilaika klimåt, basura, sustainable transportation, edukasion yan research siha gi sustainability. Ma-ranka lokkue entre 1040-1921 gi tano' entero gi performance index para i Sustainable Development Goals gi 2025.
academic-sector-desc: Programa siha undergraduate yan postgraduate ni man-akredita
academic-sector-about: I sektot inheneria ha fokus gi disenyo, konstruksion, yan dinibidi proyekto siha taiguihi guma', chalan, yan makina siha. Guaha diferensia na espesialisasion yan chumuchule' påtte gi inadilanto i lina'la' kada diha.
Research Description: I sektot sainsia ha'åni kolehio siha ni man-fokus gi basic yan applied sciences, taiguihi Sainsia yan Agrikuttura. I Sainsia guaha departamento siha taiguihi Kimika, Fisika, Computer Science, yan Geology. I fina'nå'guen-ña para u prepa graduadu siha ni siña man-cho'gue research yan development gi diferensia na fields ni sumesetbe i komunidåt yan i lina'la' gi tano'.
Scientific research and technological de: Sentro siha para Scientific Research yan Technological Development
Medical colleges and teaching hospitals: Kolehio Mediku yan Espitåt na Fina'nå'gue
Medical Description: I sektot mediku guaha Medicine, Pharmacy, Dentistry, yan Nursing, yan lokkue espitåt siha para fina'nå'gue ni manå'i healthcare services para i komunidåt yan practical training para estudiante siha. Este na fasilidåt mediku man-ekipa yan i mina' nuebu na teknolohia yan medical devices para u aseguru i takhilo' na treatment yan educational services.
Technical Description: I sektot edukasion ha'åni kolehio yan institutu siha ni man-intiresåo gi fina'cho'gue ma'estra yan espesialista siha gi edukasion, taiguihi Education yan Specific Education. Este na sektot ha aim para u adilanta i educational process yan u qualify kadres ni siña man-manå'gue i future generations yan u na'gåsgas i skills-ñiha gi diferensia na disciplines.
